title: Your First Weekend at Adelphi University, Shared as Cards
description: A guide to the essential sequence of events and campus landmarks for new Panthers during their first weekend in Garden City.

cards.title: Unpack and Settle In
cards.subtitle: Move-In Day
cards.notes: Arrive at your assigned residence hall during your specific move-in time to meet your RA and start setting up your new home.
cards.short_summary: The official start of the residential experience for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: Move-In Day for resident students is scheduled for August 20, 2026, with specific times sent to student emails.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to residential students with valid move-in appointments.

cards.title: Check In for Orientation
cards.subtitle: Orientation Weekend Kickoff
cards.notes: Head to the Flagpole Lawn at noon to officially check in for Orientation Weekend and receive your schedule of events.
cards.short_summary: The central gathering point for the start of orientation activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Check-in for Orientation at the Flagpole Lawn begins at 12:00pm on August 21, 2026.
cards.access_notes: Open to all new first-year and transfer students.

cards.title: Visit One-Stop Student Services
cards.subtitle: Lower Level, Room 008
cards.notes: Stop by the lower level to handle any last-minute billing, financial aid, or registrar questions before classes begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary administrative hub for student financial and registration needs.
cards.evidence_claim: One-Stop Student Services in Levermore Hall Lower Level is open 9:00am–4:00pm during Orientation Weekend.
cards.source_title: One-Stop Student Services Center | Adelphi University
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours; appointments are recommended but walk-ins are accepted.

cards.title: Snap a Photo with the Panther
cards.subtitle: Center for Recreation and Sports
cards.notes: Visit the bronze Panther statue outside the CRS for a classic first-weekend photo-op to show off your school spirit.
cards.short_summary: A popular campus landmark and traditional photo spot for new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Panther statue outside the Center for Recreation and Sports is a popular photo-op spot for first-year students.
cards.source_title: Ten Things You Should Do as a First-Year Student at Adelphi

cards.title: Explore the University Center
cards.subtitle: The UC
cards.notes: Check out the renovated hub for dining, the bookstore, and student lounges; it's the main social center of campus.
cards.short_summary: The central student union building featuring dining and community spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ruth S. Harley University Center (UC) serves as a hub for student life, dining, and the bookstore.
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 8:30 a.m.–10:00 p.m.

cards.title: Find a Study Spot in Nexus
cards.subtitle: Student Services Hub
cards.notes: Explore the bright, modern lounge areas and high-tech classrooms in this award-winning building.
cards.short_summary: A modern facility housing nursing labs and various student service offices.
cards.evidence_claim: The Nexus Building features bright lounge areas that serve as a social hub for students.
cards.access_notes: Open to students during building hours; houses Academic Services in room 145.

cards.title: Tour the Swirbul Library
cards.subtitle: Architectural Landmark
cards.notes: Visit this Richard Neutra-designed library to find your favorite quiet study nook or check out the gallery.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library and a significant example of modernist architecture.
cards.evidence_claim: Swirbul Library is an architectural gem designed by Richard Neutra, offering study spaces and galleries.
cards.access_notes: Adelphi ID required for certain services; check website for current weekend hours.

cards.title: Attend Matriculation
cards.subtitle: Official Welcome
cards.notes: Join your class for this formal ceremony where you are officially inducted into the Adelphi community of scholars.
cards.short_summary: A time-honored academic tradition welcoming the new incoming class.
cards.evidence_claim: Matriculation is a tradition where first-year students officially become members of the Adelphi community.
cards.access_notes: Required for all new first-year students.

cards.title: Celebrate at Pantherpalooza
cards.subtitle: Welcome Weekend Festival
cards.notes: Enjoy live music, food, and games during this festive afternoon following the Matriculation ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A high-energy campus festival held during the first weekend of the fall semester.
cards.evidence_claim: Pantherpalooza is a Welcome Weekend fest featuring spirit, fun, and food activities for new students.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typically held on campus lawns.

cards.title: Grab a Rush Ticket at the PAC
cards.subtitle: Student Performance Access
cards.notes: Check the box office for free rush tickets available to students one hour before many campus performances.
cards.short_summary: The venue for theatre, music, and dance performances on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Full-time Adelphi students are eligible for no-cost Rush tickets one hour before performances at the PAC.
cards.access_notes: Requires valid Adelphi ID; subject to availability.
